subject: Q3 Renewal — capacity staging & performance ROI recap (Novaterra)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaterra.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Renewal — capacity staging & performance ROI recap (Novaterra)

Hi Elena,

Hope you had a good weekend. As Novaterra approaches the July renewal window, I wanted to share a short health and options recap so we can lock a path that minimizes risk during your product launch in Q3. Attached is a one-page Q3 performance summary with token mix and latency snapshots.

Quick summary:
- Current run-rate: ~38M tokens/month (70% generation, 30% embedding/search).
- Request: Novaterra has occasional burst spikes (up to 1.5x daily peak) during model fine-tuning and internal experiments.
- Recommendation: stage a small committed uplift (+25% base commit) with an attached burst credit buffer (30%) for unpredictable launches.
- Expected econ: modeled ~22% unit-cost reduction after commit, plus 8–12% further reduction with KV-prefix caching we can enable on our Dedicated tier.

I've attached the Q3 summary and a proposed staging plan (spreadsheet) that lays out three scenarios (base, staged commit, staged commit + cache). Can we schedule a 30-minute sync this week to walk the numbers and confirm procurement timing? I propose Wednesday 4/14 10:30am PT — happy to move.

Also looping in Monica (CS) and Ben (AM) so we can align on rollout, SLOs, and invoicing.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: q3-performance-summary.pdf (PDF)]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaterra.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@novaterra.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Renewal — capacity staging & performance ROI recap (Novaterra)

Laura,

Thanks for the summary and for the clear scenarios — this is helpful. Wed 4/14 10:30am PT works for me; I've added Carlos from procurement to the thread so we can start the PO conversation if we land on numbers.

Before the call, could you include two quick items in the proposed plan:
1) a 95th/99th percentile latency table for our most common generation endpoints (20–80 token requests), and
2) a token mix cost breakdown (gen vs embed) showing the per-token rate assumptions used to calculate the 22% reduction.

We want to be sure finance and engineering understand the cost/latency tradeoffs before procurement approves a multi-month commit.

See you Wednesday.

—Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of AI Platform, Novaterra
elena@novaterra.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaterra.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Renewal — capacity staging & performance ROI recap (Novaterra)

Elena — great to connect this morning. Per our call, attaching the detailed staging plan and the latency/cost tables you asked for. Key call notes and commitments below: 

Quoted attachments: proposed-staging-plan.xlsx, q3-performance-summary.pdf

Summary of agreed points from call:
- Base: keep current commit (12 months) and operationalize KV-prefix caching (no cost change) — expected latency 95th: 180ms, 99th: 420ms.
- Staged uplift: +25% commit for 6 months (trial window), with 30% burst credits available for launches. Expected blended unit cost: $0.00185/token (from $0.00238), ~22% reduction.
- Cache + batching optimization (optimize batching policy for short sequences) estimated to reduce token usage from generated tokens by 6–10% depending on prompt patterns.
- Rollout plan: 2-week validation in staging, then enable burst credits for the next product launch window.
- Operational SLAs: maintain <500ms 99th across our Dedicated pool; we'll provide trace-level sampling for the first month after rollout.

Next steps (action owners):
- Redwood (Laura/Ben): share final term sheet with proposed pricing and invoice contact (today) — see attached term sheet v2.
- Novaterra (Elena/Carlos): confirm procurement timing and any PO process constraints (Carlos).
- Redwood (Monica): prepare enablement checklist and KV prefix onboarding doc.

Carlos — tagging you directly: if procurement can target a PO issued by 4/23 we can lock staged pricing and schedule the uplift for 5/1. Let us know if net-30 is required or any additional paperwork.

Thanks all — attaching the spreadsheet and perf tables as discussed.

Best,
Laura
[Attachment: proposed-staging-plan.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: redwood-term-sheet-v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@novaterra.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@novaterra.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Renewal — capacity staging & performance ROI recap (Novaterra)

Laura / Elena,

Procurement reviewed the term sheet and staging plan. Good news — pricing looks aligned with our expectations. We have two administrative redlines before we can issue the PO:
1) We need a clause adding a 30-day review period after the staging uplift where either party can revert the uplift in writing (operational rollback).
2) Standard indemnity language needs a small modification for our legal team (I attached the requested markup to the DocuSign link).

On payment terms: Novaterra prefers net-30 from invoice date — will that be acceptable? Please confirm the invoice contact (email and billing address) and we can target PO issuance 4/22 to hit your 5/1 uplift.

Once the redlines are accepted I can pull the PO trigger.

Carlos Mendez
Director of Procurement | Novaterra
carlos.m@novaterra.com | +1 415-555-0166
